profile.shortBio: I am an undergraduate Mechanical Engineering student and a Mechatronics minor student at TOBB ETÜ. Within Formula Student, I work on mechanical design, powertrain and braking systems, while developing design automation and engineering calculation tools in C++. My main areas of interest are mechanical design, robotics, control and the integration of manufacturing processes with software.

items.title: Formula Student · Powertrain, Braking Systems and Design Automation
items.description: I work on mechanical design, powertrain and braking systems in the TOBB ETÜ Racing Formula Student team. While contributing to the design and preparation for manufacturing of machine elements used in powertrain components, I also develop C++ based automation tools to accelerate engineering calculations and revision processes.
items.announcementsHtml: Areas of work: mechanical design, powertrain systems, braking systems, manufacturability, system optimization and engineering automation with C++.

items.title: Electronic Warfare Systems · Mechanical Design
items.description: As the mechanical engineer on the TEKNOFEST Electronic Warfare project team, I worked on modeling radio antennas in Fusion 360, mechanical validation against wind loads and the weight of electronic equipment, and the design of shared mechanical components. I used MATLAB based calculations for structural and load analyses.
items.announcementsHtml: The project progressed to the Conceptual Design Report stage. The mechanical designs were adapted according to the electronic hardware requirements of the two subsystems.

items.title: TOBB ETÜ Student Discount Card Project
items.description: I played an active role in implementing MYTH Card, one of the first comprehensive student discount card projects at TOBB ETÜ. I was involved in establishing cooperation between students and local businesses, institutional meetings, project marketing and the management of operational processes.
items.announcementsHtml: The project process allowed me to gain experience in communication, time management, institutional collaboration and operational coordination.
